gates.name: Authenticated realtime search and result verification

evidence_required: Probe PROMO-RESULT covers FT-004-AC-001, FT-004-AC-002, FT-004-AC-003, FT-004-AC-006, REQ-SRCH-001, REQ-SRCH-002, REQ-SRCH-003, REQ-CAP-003, REQ-DIAG-001 and the integrated result/failure claims in .memory-bank/domains/realtime-search.md#failure-and-deadline-behavior, .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#result-session-shape, .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#edge-cases-and-errors, .memory-bank/contracts/realtime-attempt-api.md#response-version-1 and .memory-bank/contracts/realtime-attempt-api.md#admission-idempotency-and-failures. RED: before production changes, authenticated mixed-scope, ordered/repeated/low-quality, weak/tied/repeated-Photo, partial-ready, missing-date and fewer-than-four fixtures must show the fake downstream cannot produce the accepted search decisions, deterministic pools, four unique teasers, complete union, exact N or explicit outcomes/session relationship; a successful-session fixture must separately show that exact response/session fields, 30-minute first-open expiry, atomic result_issued/result/display_status=pending publication and field-for-field terminal reconstruction are absent; injected core-Attempt owner-write, production processing-boundary and result-publication transaction failures must show that the current path cannot guarantee standard 5xx, safe internal_failure recording, zero downstream inference after a failed core write or zero partial result/session publication. GREEN: the claim-equivalent success matrix records separate results for active context and every search scope, selected/gated detection, threshold-valid match, pHash-only rank/tie, reserved/diverse/fallback decision, teaser uniqueness, union/N reconciliation, missing-date 503 with no admission/search, current partial-ready visibility, unacceptable_query, insufficient_results and repeated-Photo deduplication. Its publication branch records one face_moment.promo_sessions row whose session_id, ordered complete union, exactly four ordered unique teaser IDs, exact N, spa/date, qr_issued_at and qr_first_open_expires_at reconcile field-for-field with the accepted Response Version 1 including four ordered same-origin media_url values, one same-origin qr_url and exactly 30 minutes between issue and first-open expiry; the same promo transaction records processing_status=result_issued, domain_outcome=result and display_status=pending, with neither half visible at the transaction boundary. A terminal repeat must return the same session_id, ordered teaser objects/URLs, N, qr_url ticket and expiry field-for-field, create no row and invoke no inference/search. Its failure branch records distinguishable results for: failed core-Attempt commit -> 5xx, no Attempt/session and zero processing calls; each injected TASK-011 native query-engine, PostgreSQL repository, pgvector exact-query or private-preview/pHash failure after admission -> 5xx, the existing Attempt set to internal_failure when the owner write can safely commit, no domain result and no session/partial matches; injected session-insert or Attempt-result transition failure -> transaction rollback with no half-published session or result_issued/pending state, followed by internal_failure only when a separate owner write can safely commit. Retain exact responses and repeat diff, Attempt/session rows and transaction visibility, inference counters, injected fault locators, search/assembly trace, decisive comparisons and owned cleanup under .tasks/TASK-012-T3-FT-004-W4/.

Probe PROMO-SECURITY covers FT-004-AC-005, REQ-SEC-001, .memory-bank/domains/display-client-access.md, .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#result-session-shape, .memory-bank/contracts/realtime-attempt-api.md#response-version-1, .memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#active-search-date and the task-applicable Realtime Attempt API authentication/failure claims. RED: an isolated public/staff/session matrix must fail at least one claim for valid/absent/foreign/reset/body-overridden/rate-limited display requests, token-derived spa, token/ticket redaction, private services, operator-only active-date GET/PUT with session/role/CSRF/unknown-spa/invalid-date handling, or digest-only QR-ticket persistence; the result branch must specifically fail if plaintext ticket/secret is stored or logged, the stored digest does not equal SHA-256 of the issued opaque ticket, or the ticket appears outside the accepted qr_url. GREEN: the claim-equivalent matrix records separate results for every realtime 200/401/429 and override rejection, configured token/IP limit, authoritative spa row, no display token/digest/Auth material in body/URL/logs, HTTPS-only/private topology, exact active-date page/GET/PUT fields, operator 200, session 401, role/CSRF 403, unknown 404 and invalid/unknown-field 422, plus atomic settings-revision increment and no foreign writer. For the successful result it extracts the opaque ticket only inside the accepted same-origin qr_url, proves the persisted qr_ticket_hash_sha256 equals SHA-256 of that ticket, proves neither plaintext ticket nor deployment QR-ticket secret exists in owner tables, responses outside qr_url, URLs outside that query, logs or retained artifacts, and proves the idempotent repeat yields the same ticket/digest pair without another secret-bearing write. Retain effective topology, exact responses, database rows/digest comparison, log/artifact scan and pass/fail comparisons in authorized disposable state.

Probe PROMO-RUNTIME covers FT-004-AC-007, FT-004-AC-008, REQ-REL-001, REQ-DIAG-001 and .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#singleton-runtime-orchestration. RED: a held-slot/concurrent-request plus accepted/searching restart matrix must fail because one non-blocking slot/deadline, typed busy Attempt, interruption and no-replay publication do not exist. GREEN: the same controlled-clock matrix records the owner Attempt and inference call, the concurrent distinct Attempt returning busy before release with zero inference/wait/resume, slot/search stage timestamps, configured deadline and no late session, fresh-only acquisition after release/deadline, restart transitions for both pre-slot and active-search states, zero replay/late result/session and one fresh post-start request; each claim has a separate observed result, comparison, raw invocation/row trace, safe rerun and owned cleanup.

Probe PROMO-CORRECTNESS covers the task-applicable server-result claim in FT-004-AC-004, REQ-PERF-001, REQ-CAP-003 and .memory-bank/testing/client-realtime.md#reference-search-and-joint-correctness-proof. RED: before production behavior changes, the fixed 20-attempt corpus cannot produce four-teaser/complete-union result rows to review against represented selected detections. GREEN: an authorized pilot evaluator manually reviews every returned teaser and every union photo_id against the stable participant/detection ground truth, records a separate correctness boolean and reason per attempt, observed correct-count/20 and pass/fail comparison requiring at least 19 server-correct attempts, and retains the signed review table plus raw result/selection artifact keyed by attempt_id. The artifact explicitly remains joinable to later FT-005 physical QR rows and does not claim the final joint feature verdict, QR visibility or group-member coverage.

Probe PROMO-OWNERSHIP covers FT-004-AC-001, FT-004-AC-003, FT-004-AC-007, REQ-ARCH-001 and the Participant Promo/application-boundary claims. RED: a static/integration trace must fail because serving_control-owned date/settings, processing-owned search and promo-owned slot/assembly/session boundaries are not all present behind the existing adapters. GREEN: the same trace records the serving_control staff principal handoff and owner writes, TASK-011 typed processing call/output, promo slot/result transaction and separate negative results for direct foreign repositories or business orchestration in HTTP/UI, platform/auth, infrastructure, generic helpers and composition roots.

Migration evidence records the actual pre-task linear Alembic head, direct down_revision, upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade, active-date/settings/Attempt-stage/result-session constraints including digest-only QR-ticket and exact issue/expiry fields, atomic result publication, preserved dependency data and no ownership-crossing Photo cascade without making a later mutable head an exact requirement; this supports but does not replace the PROMO-RESULT and PROMO-SECURITY RED/GREEN results.

All T3 probes use one unique disposable Compose project, synthetic commercial media/proposals, generated display/staff tokens, a disposable QR-ticket secret, deterministic settings/clock/deadline, task-owned object prefix, safe rerun, redaction and owned cleanup. They never touch production credentials/media, operator/default volumes or broaden permissions. Independent /verify supplies fresh functional evidence and VERDICT: PASS for every harm-driving claim; per-task /red-verify supplies SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass before the explicit lifecycle owner records closure.
purpose: Replace the admitted fake realtime downstream with the complete promo-owned FT-004 outcome while preserving owner boundaries, the exact public contract and safe singleton/restart behavior.
success_outcome: An authenticated bounded request with a complete active context either atomically returns one persisted four-teaser result session with N equal to the complete threshold-valid union or a precise typed/standard non-success; concurrent and restarted work never waits, replays or publishes late, and the operator can set the authoritative active date through the protected owner surface.
anti_goals: Do not change FT-003 capture, multipart, display-token or core-admission contracts; extend the accepted downstream and Attempt state only.
Do not implement FT-005 Promo rendering, Chime, QR visibility/display acknowledgement/cooldown or claim the final joint 20-attempt verdict.
Do not implement FT-006 QR exchange, phone continuation/browser access/expiry, FT-007 detailed diagnostics, Calibration or FT-012 inventory operations.

Do not add ANN, waiter/replay queue, broker, distributed limiter, second realtime process, killable inference subprocess, pHash cache, tracking/clustering, generic settings/session/error framework or automatic date/threshold change.

forbidden_scope: Changes to approved FT-001/FT-002/FT-003 task identities, request multipart/body contract or display-client credential lifecycle
FT-005 Promo/QR render and acknowledgement, FT-006 phone/access/expiry, FT-007+ diagnostics/Calibration/inventory behavior
Production credentials/media/deployment, operator/default volumes, destructive primary-data actions or permission expansion
ANN, broker/waiter/replay/distributed coordination, extra realtime process, pHash cache/lifecycle, tracking/clustering and generic settings/session/error frameworks
stop_conditions: Execution requires changing the active-date role/API, realtime response/outcome, candidate-pool/N algorithm, singleton/deadline/restart behavior, result-session identity or accepted joint criterion.
Orchestration cannot remain under promo, date/settings under serving_control and search under processing without direct foreign writes, a new module/edge or forbidden technical placement.
A missing date cannot remain pre-admission 503 or busy/deadline/interrupted work cannot avoid inference replay and late session publication under the accepted one-process topology.

Any harm-driving auth/token/ticket/result-publication/technical-failure/runtime/restart RED/GREEN probe cannot run in already authorized isolated disposable state with safe rerun, redaction and owned cleanup.

constraints: Primary orchestration owner is promo at src/face_moment/promo/; serving_control owns active date/settings, processing supplies TASK-011 search truth and transport/composition only adapt.
Reuse TASK-004 staff sessions for the exact operator active-date surface and TASK-009 display-token/core-Attempt admission without introducing parallel authentication or request contracts.
Author one migration from the actual current linear head for owner-held context/stage/result-session data and verify only direct ancestry, transition and data behavior.

Use one process-local non-blocking slot and one positive configured deadline; persist the admitted Attempt before the slot decision and publish a result session only in the owner-local atomic result transaction.

Use deterministic candidate and QR-ticket reconstruction rules from the canonical specs; exact owner-local module/template filenames and positive deadline/threshold values remain executor/configuration discretion.
invariants: The authoritative spa comes only from the active display-token principal and visit_date only from serving_control; client body/clock cannot override either.
Four teasers are unique threshold-valid union members and N equals the complete unique valid-photo union; pHash never admits a weak match or changes N.
A missing active date creates no core Attempt/search; insufficient, busy, deadline and interrupted work creates no result session.
A busy Attempt never waits or resumes, one deadline governs the owner request and restart/late work never replays or publishes a session.
Tokens, ticket material, credentials, personalized result payloads and private storage identities never enter URLs except the accepted opaque QR query, logs or public infrastructure exposure.
verification_targets: PROMO-RESULT -> FT-004-AC-001, FT-004-AC-002, FT-004-AC-003, FT-004-AC-006, REQ-SRCH-001, REQ-SRCH-002, REQ-SRCH-003, REQ-CAP-003, REQ-DIAG-001, .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#result-session-shape, .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#edge-cases-and-errors and .memory-bank/contracts/realtime-attempt-api.md#response-version-1 with separate context/search/selection/gate/pool/tie/teaser/union-N outcomes; exact persisted session/response/30-minute expiry; atomic result_issued/result/display_status=pending; field-for-field no-inference repeat; failed core write; admitted native-query-engine/PostgreSQL-repository/pgvector-exact-query/private-preview 5xx/internal_failure; and rolled-back result-publication results with zero partial session.
